```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning= FALSE, results = 'hide'}
library(kableExtra)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(downloadthis)
Sample_Name <- params$name
Name <- params$samplename
```


<hr style="border: 1px solid white; width: 100%; margin:0px; padding:0px;" />

**`r Name`** ---
  `r Sys.Date()` ---
**`r Sample_Name`** 
<hr style="border: 1px solid white; width: 100%; margin:0px; padding:0px;" />




```{r, include=FALSE,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
#Read in table 6 and 7 
Table6 <- read.csv(params$Table6)
Table7 <- read.csv(params$Table7)

```


```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
Table6 %>% 
  download_this(
    output_name = paste0(Sys.Date(), "_Table6.Transdecoder.Top 100 distinct transcripts with Hits by Bitscore_", Name),
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download distinct transcript as csv",
    button_type = "primary",
    csv2 = FALSE,
  )
```


```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
Table7 %>% 
  download_this(
    output_name = paste0(Sys.Date(), "_Table7.Transdecoder.Top 100 distinct Hits by Bitscore_", Name),
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download distinct hits as csv",
    button_type = "primary",
    csv2 = FALSE,
  )
```

# Top 100 Sorted by Bit Score, Distinct Transcripts

```{r,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
Table6 %>%
  kable("html", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        escape = FALSE) %>%  # Escape = FALSE to render HTML
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, 
                position = "center") %>% 
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm", bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "black") %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, font_size = 14, color = "white", background = "black") 
```

# Top 100 Sorted by Bit Score, Distinct Hits
```{r,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
Table7 %>%
  kable("html", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        escape = FALSE) %>%  # Escape = FALSE to render HTML
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE, 
                position = "center") %>% 
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm", bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "black") %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, font_size = 14, color = "white", background = "black")
```
